Welcome to Blue Fish Cottage—A Naturally Buffered Escape in Charming Seagrove Beach!

Tucked away in the quiet, scenic streets of Cassine Village, Blue Fish Cottage offers a unique setting that combines the best of 30A living: quick access to the beach and a peaceful retreat buffered by natural green spaces.

If you are looking for an escape that is set back from the noise and traffic of 30A, but still offers a short stroll or a quick bike ride to the famous sugar-white sand, you have found your ideal home base.

UNIQUE COTTAGE & NATURAL PRIVACY

Blue Fish Cottage offers a distinctive sense of privacy and full outdoor living:

Natural Buffer: The home backs up to the undeveloped wooded interior of the street circle, giving you rare and peaceful green views.

Complete Outdoor Living: Enjoy the colorful rocking chairs on the front porch, the large screened-in back porch with bistro table and lounge area, and the dedicated outdoor patio featuring a charcoal grill, additional seating, and dining area—perfect for summer BBQs!

Side Buffer: The property is further buffered on one side by a small neighborhood nature park.

THE CASSINE VILLAGE DIFFERENCE (INCLUDED AMENITIES)

Cassine Village is widely loved for its family-friendly, low-traffic environment and incredible amenities included with your stay:

Pools & Courts: Access to Two Community Pools and dedicated Tennis & Pickleball Courts.

Signature Trails: Step right onto the community nature paths, including scenic boardwalks that travel over cypress swamps and wetlands. These trails offer immediate access to the beautiful Point Washington State Forest for hiking, camping, mountain biking and exploration.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (4 Bedrooms / 3 Full Baths – Sleeps 8)

The meticulously maintained home offers an ideal, spacious layout for families or groups:

Primary Suite: King Bed with a private ensuite bathroom.

Bedroom 2: Queen Bed (Shares Jack & Jill Bathroom).

Bedroom 3: Two Twin Beds (Shares Jack & Jill Bathroom)—perfect for children.

Bedroom 4: Queen Bed (Access to the home's 3rd Full Bath).

Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa

INTERIOR FEATURES & KITCHEN

Kitchen: Well-designed, well-stocked kitchen featuring granite countertops and stainless steel appliances.

Technology: All bedrooms and the living area are equipped with modern Smart TVs.

Flooring: Classic hardwood floors throughout the main living areas.

LOCATION & ACCESS

Beach: Approximately 900 yards to the newly renovated One Seagrove public beach access. It’s a short, pleasant walk or quick bike ride.

Walkability: Within easy walking distance of excellent local restaurants (Perfect Pig, Brozinni Pizzeria, Hokulia Shave Ice, etc.), retail shops, and Goatfeathers Seafood Market.

Bike Rentals: Bikes are easily rented nearby for a fun and fast way to explore all of 30A!

Nearby: Blue Fish Cottage in Seagrove Beach, FL is perfectly positioned between and within a short, easy drive of Seaside/Watercolor/Grayton Beach to the west, and Alys/Rosemary Beach to the east.

We look forward to sharing our wonderful cottage beach escape with you and your family. See you at Blue Fish!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.label: Excellent
reviews.text: What a JOY to stay at the Blue Fish Cottage! The house was wonderful- clean, comfortable, and as described on the listing. Theres a cutthrough across the street that makes the walk to the beach so easy. King and the property managment company were SO responsive when we had questions and needed anything. We love being so close to some of our favorites- takeout shrimp from Goatfeathers, ice cream just down the street, and obviously- hours in the sunshine at the beach. We would definitely stay here again!
